messages:
sam (eng-sre): Postmortem published: INC-1827. Root cause: KV cache eviction cascade -> request amplification. We pulled a few concrete runbook fixes.

sam (eng-sre): Action list (owners/dates):
- Add KV health triage block (owner: maria, due: 2025-05-09)
- Add 'safe-mode' containment commands + diagnostics (owner: devon, due: 2025-05-12)
- Explicit escalation ladder for autoscaler failures (owner: ana, due: 2025-05-08)
- Add recurring incident flagging to pager and 30d trend review (owner: sam, due: 2025-05-20)

maria (eng-platform): I'll take the KV triage block. Plan: check hit ratio, TTL skew, recent eviction timestamps, and a one-click fallback toggle.

devon (eng-runtime): Taking safe-mode. Drafting quick commands for the runbook here for review:

```
# safe-mode: reduce concurrency and set readonly cache
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference annotate deployment/inference-api redwood/safe-mode=true
kubectl exec -n inference deployment/inference-api -- /bin/sh -c "export KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly && supervisorctl restart inference"
# diagnostics: dump prefix sizes and last eviction
kubectl exec -n inference deployment/inference-api -- /bin/sh -c "python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=50"
```

devon (eng-runtime): I'll include parseable output examples so oncall can grep quickly.

ana (typo)

ana -> ana (infra): adding telemetry query for eviction spike detection and a simple curl probe to measure cache fullness. I'll paste query in PR.

maria (eng-platform): For escalation ladder, suggest: @oncall-sre -> @platform-pager if no ack in 5m -> page infra lead after 15m -> exec oncall manager after 30m. Makes the timeline explicit.

ana (again typo)

ana -> ana (infra): ack, I'll own the escalation wording and add contact rotation links and runbook snippet to page channels.

sam (eng-sre): Good. Also add an entry to the header linking to the postmortem and mark the runbook with a "recurring-pattern" tag so it shows up in the monthly digest.

maria (eng-platform): PR incoming: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-draft. PR #472. Added checklist items and sample queries + links to dashboards. Assigning to @ana and @devon for review.

runbook-bot: Runbook draft created by maria. PR #472.

devon (eng-runtime): One thought: should runbook include an optional fallback to a lower-capacity model variant if cache health stays bad? Might be separate Optimize action.

sam (eng-sre): Let's open a ticket for Optimize. For the runbook, keep to triage and containment only.

ana (infra): Added Grafana query sample in PR comments and a curl check for prefix saturation: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/cache/prefix/health | jq .filled_ratio`.

maria (eng-platform): Scheduling a 30m walkthrough for oncall team to go over new steps on 2025-05-07 15:00 UTC.

sam (eng-sre): I'll create reminders and follow-up thread for the walkthrough notes. If owners need to shift dates, reply here.

runbook-bot: Reminder set: runbook walkthrough 2025-05-07 15:00 UTC (invite sent).

maria (eng-platform): After walkthrough, I'll merge PR and set the runbook version.

sam (eng-sre): Thanks all. Closing this thread when PR is merged and walkthrough done. :thumbsup:
